Container.Name: smart-garage
Container.Overview: Smart Garage — self-hosted vehicle management for Unraid. Maintenance, fuel analytics, expenses, documents, and reminders. One container, SQLite database, automatic updates via :latest image.
Container.Description:
**Smart Garage** helps you manage your cars from your own NAS — no cloud, no subscription.
**Features**
- Vehicle profiles with photos, specs, modifications and odometer tracking
- Maintenance schedules, service log with parts and fluids, due/overdue dashboard
- Fuel log with consumption charts and projected annual usage
- Expenses, document storage (PDF/receipts), notes and reminders
- Push notifications via Pushover or Telegram (background delivery)
- Share vehicles with family members; JSON backup with restore
- Installable as an app (PWA) on phone, tablet and desktop
- Dark/light theme, 9 design presets, English and German UI
- Metric or imperial: km or miles, litres or US gallons (L/100km or MPG)
- Hide fields you don't need and add your own custom fields
- Open local registration (first user becomes admin), optional OIDC single sign-on
**First run**
1. Install and start the container
2. Open the WebUI
3. Register your account
4. Add your first vehicle
**Updates:** Docker → smart-garage → **Force Update** (pulls `latest` from GHCR).
**Backup:** archive the AppData folder (`smart-garage.db` + `uploads/`).
Docs: https://github.com/flizzy27/smart-garage/blob/main/docs/UNRAID.md

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: SQLite database and uploads. Created automatically by Unraid.

Config.Name: SSO: issuer URL
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Base URL of your OpenID Connect provider, e.g. https://id.example.com (Pocket ID, Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia). Leave empty to keep username/password login only. Guide: https://github.com/flizzy27/smart-garage/blob/main/docs/OIDC.md

Config.Name: SSO: client ID
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Client ID registered with your provider.

Config.Name: SSO: client secret
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Client secret registered with your provider.

Config.Name: SSO: button label
Config.Description: Optional. Text on the login button, e.g. 'Pocket ID'. Defaults to 'Single Sign-On'.

Config.Name: SSO: redirect URI
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed behind a reverse proxy that does not forward X-Forwarded-Proto/Host. Example: https://garage.example.com/api/auth/oidc/callback

Config.Name: SSO: allow account creation
Config.Description: Optional. 'false' only lets people sign in who already have an account here. Default is 'true'.
